answer: Latent duplicate whisper tracing. Each agent identity gets an invisible per-instance behavioral watermark (typing cadence, tool-call sequencing quirks) embedded in its observable outputs. After the fact, a clustering pass groups identities whose watermark residuals correlate above threshold, flagging likely sybils. An attacker must forge a distinct, stable watermark per identity by suppressing or randomizing idiosyncratic signals—costing live-model retraining or per-call perturbation that degrades task quality and doubles compute. A single walnut of unmatched noise breaks the cluster.
